videos.desc: An animated man sits on a hard window bench and winces, rubbing his sore back. He fetches a yellow cushion, sits on it happily, then comically piles up more and more cushions and gives a thumbs up.
videos.said: Ouch! It's not enough. Ah, yes.

videos.desc: In a high-rise apartment an older man shows off his dining table: he slides it apart, drops extension leaves into the middle and the table grows to twice its length; he celebrates, planks on the matching bench and finally sits at the huge table.

An anime girl opens a big wooden wardrobe packed with hanging coats and folded sweaters. She browses the hangers, holds a yellow coat and a red dress against herself, gets buried when scarves and a hat tumble off the shelf, then stuffs everything back and shuts the doors.

A slow tour of a loft flat as the day ends. Low sun throws long bars across the herringbone floor and a big round red paper lantern glows beside the window. The kitchen is lit only by a strip under the units, then a warm orange paper lantern hangs over a bed facing the city skyline at dusk, and finally strings of bulbs and candles light a roof terrace at night.

A plain bedroom with a woven wall hanging above an enormous bed made up in white. A row of seven identical white pillows is lined up along the head of the bed against the wall. A woman in a black top and grey joggers climbs onto the end of the bed and crawls slowly up the middle of it on her hands and knees, dragging the white duvet into long folds behind her. When she reaches the top she turns, drops back against the row of pillows and flings her arms out wide, lying flat with the pillows behind her head.

In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.

An animated walk-in wardrobe. A hand points along a completely bare wooden shelf and an empty hanging rail on one side of the room, then sweeps across to the other side. The camera pulls back to show the whole wardrobe crammed with pink and purple clothes on the rails and folded in stacks on every shelf, with a deep heap of clothes covering the floor. A muscular cartoon man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers stands in the middle of the heap staring at it, and the shot closes in on his shocked face.
videos.said: This is your side, and this is my side, okay? Okay. Where am I supposed to put my clothes? Here, put them here.

videos.desc: A man in a grey jumper sits on a sofa in a sunlit living room and reaches for a folded blanket beside him. He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.

A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.

Three shots of people looking up at what is above them indoors. A man lies flat on a bed and stares up at a plain white surface with a single bare bulb on a round fitting. A woman on a sofa leans back and looks up at the wooden beams and rafters of a bright open room. A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.

Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.

A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.

In a flat with a parquet floor a man lifts the body of a plastic bin off a full bin bag, then tips a cardboard box of odds and ends into a bigger box on the floor. He pulls a metal drawer out of a cabinet and empties that in too. By the end the whole living room floor is buried under a spreading heap of toys, boxed games, plastic tubs and building blocks, and he stands behind the emptied cabinet holding it, mouth open at the state of the room.

A sunny tropical back garden by a pool. A woman in swimwear holds a tall glass under a brass garden tap and lets the water run into it until it brims over. She then tips a grey metal jug with a curved handle and pours a long stream of water from it into a rainbow-striped watering can, and pours another jug of water into a big black bucket. Finally she stands over a blue inflatable paddling pool and fills it with a green garden hose while friends on sun loungers behind her cheer and raise their arms.

A long narrow passage inside a flat, white walls on both sides, coat racks with jackets hanging on each wall and two long rows of shoes on the floor. A woman carries a laundry basket down the passage towards the camera; two men squeeze past her carrying a big cardboard box over a bicycle parked in the passage; at the end the passage is empty again, with only the shoes and coats and a blue door at the far end.

A young man in a knitted vest holds up a blue shirt, slides a wooden hanger into it and smooths the shoulders and sleeves flat. He holds the finished shirt up straight so the collar and buttons sit square. He then carries it to an open wardrobe where a long rail of shirts hangs sorted by colour, from white through blue to orange and dark green, and slides his shirt into its place in the row, evening up the neighbouring shirts with his hand.

A man in a colourful tie-dye shirt and glasses stands over a bed heaped with a big pile of crumpled clothes. He pulls a badly creased blue shirt out of the heap and pulls a face at the state of it, then irons it flat on a board and finally holds it up, smooth, beside a rail of hanging shirts.

At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.

In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.

A man in a white linen shirt stands at an open window with jungle and rice terraces behind it. He presses a tiny seedling into the soil of a terracotta pot standing on the windowsill, then lifts a metal watering can and pours water over it. The shot opens onto a room crowded with indoor plants - monsteras, ferns and trailing vines in pots on the floor, on stands and hanging in baskets from the ceiling - and he stands among them looking up at them.

A man in a denim shirt sits alone in a grey armchair in a bright open-plan home, drinking from a white mug. He leans back on a colourful patchwork sofa and stretches both arms out along the backrest, taking up the whole seat. The shot then opens onto a very large, almost empty living room with a huge grey sectional sofa running around three sides of the floor, the man sitting by himself in the middle of it with a wall-mounted television behind him. People run in from both sides and throw themselves onto the sectional, kicking their legs up and cheering, and by the end a dozen friends are spread out around the whole sofa with room to spare, waving at the camera.

Two girls play in a bedroom that holds two identical white beds side by side, matching headboards and matching bare mattresses. They flop back onto one bed each, laughing at the camera. Sitting cross-legged on the beds they thread coloured beads into bracelets from a tray and fasten one onto the other girl's wrist. Then they pull jackets on in front of a tall mirror and dance together on the carpet.

An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.

A young man in a rust t-shirt and jeans presses his back against a pink wall on a steep, narrow stone stairway and holds up one end of a big mustard velvet sofa, tilted diagonally between the walls. Below, a young woman in a lilac t-shirt and shorts pushes the lower end, laughing and looking up at him. The sofa shifts a little as they strain. A fallen cushion lies on a step. Colourful houses, a whale mural, green railings, red geraniums and a harbour with ships far below surround them.

In a bright bedroom with a tall window and white curtains, a young woman with curly hair, a black slip dress and a black leather jacket stands beside a tall dark-wood chest of drawers with brass handles. Its drawers are pulled open and stuffed with jeans, jumpers and scarves. She throws a bundle of colourful scarves into the air, pulls a pair of jeans out of a drawer and tosses it, then pulls out a striped sock and holds it up. An unmade bed covered in clothes and tulips in a vase complete the room.

In a bright loft flat with tall factory windows and brick walls, a young woman in a sage green crop top, matching leggings, white socks and sunglasses walks in through a heavy steel door and tosses things behind and around her: a black jacket flies through the air and white trainers land on the concrete floor. She walks forward, pushes up her sunglasses and holds a water bottle. A bag sits by the door, a grey cat rests on a leather sofa and plants stand by the windows.

An old living room being redecorated. A young woman with a dark bob and glasses, a mustard cardigan and cream trousers stands on a wooden stepladder and reaches up as a large piece of green velvet fabric flies through the air; it falls past her and unrolls across the floor. She pushes her glasses up and then holds up a measuring tape. The walls are painted mustard. Fabric and paint samples lie on the wooden floor, a sofa is wrapped in plastic, the fireplace is covered with a dust sheet and sunlight comes through tall bay windows.

On a rainy summer day, a laughing young woman with curly hair, a knotted white shirt and denim shorts roller-skates along the wet floorboards of a long covered wooden porch beside a white house, coming towards the viewer and spreading her arms wide. A ceiling fan turns overhead, ferns hang in baskets, and a white rocking chair, tall shuttered doors and a jug of iced tea on the white railing line the porch. A dog lies on the boards behind her.

A tall old stairwell with a curving wooden handrail and a big arched window. On the wooden landing halfway up the stairs stands a black grand piano, and a young removal man in a grey T-shirt sits on a cardboard box and plays it while an orange cat walks along the piano. At the end he throws both arms up. His workmates rest on the steps below among moving blankets, one wakes up and claps, and another sits against the wall. Above, neighbours with coffee cups lean over the banisters of the upper floors and smile.

A shabby small kitchen in a rented flat. Water drips into a saucepan on the tiled floor between two pairs of feet. The view rises to a bearded young man in a navy quilted jacket, checked shirt and chinos, holding a clipboard and a bunch of keys, who scratches his neck and winces up at a large brown water stain on the ceiling. Beside him a young woman in a black hoodie with long braids stands with her arms folded. Mould grows in the corners, mugs stand by the cooker and a calendar hangs on the wall.

An old black wood-burning stove stands with its door open in a dim cottage room. Inside, a small white firelighter cube burns under a pile of kindling sticks and split logs, and its flame grows taller and brighter as the sticks catch fire, with sparks and thin smoke rising. On the stone hearth in front lie an opened box of white firelighter cubes with crumbs around it, worn leather gloves and a small brush and dustpan. A basket of birch logs stands beside the stove under a window.

In an elegant sitting room at night with a big stone fireplace, a young man in a black dinner suit crouches on the stone floor and pushes a long metal poker into the fire. A huge burst of flame and orange sparks shoots up. He stands up and walks away from the fireplace, holding the poker with its tip still burning. Behind him guests in evening dresses and dinner jackets sit on sofas and watch. Logs, a hearth brush, tongs and a coal bucket lie on the floor.

An old stairwell with a curving iron banister, tiled walls and a stained glass window. Two young men carry a heavy teal velvet sofa on the stone stairs, one at the bottom and one at the top. A young woman lies stretched out on the sofa in a cream jumper and jeans, calmly reading a book, and puts her arm behind her head, completely relaxed. Moving boxes, a palm plant and a cushion on the stairs are around them.

A narrow hallway with dark green walls and a speckled stone floor, with moving boxes stacked around. A long orange sofa lies stuck in front of the doorway while two young men push it from behind. A young woman in a mustard cardigan grabs it and tips it up on its end, so it stands upright and can fit through the doorway. Behind her the two young men watch, and one raises both hands in surprise. A bicycle hangs on the wall and a potted plant stands by the boxes.

An attic bedroom with a leaking skylight. Water drips steadily from the wet, stained ceiling onto the old wooden floor, where a bucket and pans catch it. A young woman in a burgundy jumper with damp hair hugs a black guitar case tightly to her chest with her eyes closed. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers crouches beside her, smiles and holds out a checked cloth, then moves the pans and slips out of view as the view moves closer to her. A chest of drawers with an oil lamp is behind.

A house party in a small flat at night, with fairy lights and a window full of city lights. In front, a young man in a dark red satin shirt holds a yellow spirit level on top of one of the small framed pictures on the wall and keeps adjusting it with a serious face, even though it already hangs straight. Behind him his friends dance, a young woman in a silver sequinned top swings her hair, and a young woman in a mustard cardigan with a drink reaches out and taps his shoulder.

A young woman with long red hair in a cream jumper, navy trousers and yellow shoes stands on the metal balcony of a stone lighthouse with a red lamp room. She takes a striped towel off a washing line where jumpers and jeans flap in the wind, folds it, lays it over the railing and leans on it, laughing, above a grey, foaming sea. Pots of herbs stand on the grated floor, rubber boots wait by the open red door, and a cat sits in the doorway.
